job.title: Disability Support Workers – Shoalhaven, Batemans Bay & Sydney
job.description:
Now Hiring: Everyday Legends (aka Disability Support Workers) | Shoalhaven, Batemans Bay & Sydney

Do you have the patience of a saint, the humor of a stand-up comic, and the multitasking skills of a parent on a Monday morning? Then you might just be our next in-home care hero.
We’re calling on caring, reliable, and passionate legends who love helping others live comfortably and confidently at home. If you can turn a tough day around, keep calm in the chaos, and still nail the classic “How was your day?” chat — we want you on our team.

What You’ll Be Doing (Your Daily Missions)

  • Assisting with personal care such as showers, dressing, and grooming — the real-life essentials
  • Supporting participants to remain comfortable, confident, and independent in their own homes
  • Helping with everyday routines and activities
  • Following individual support plans with care and professionalism
  • Observing changes, noticing the little things, and communicating effectively with the wider team

What You’ll Need in Your Utility Belt

  • Minimum 3 months’ experience in disability, or mental health support
  • Cert III or IV in Individual Support, Disability, or Mental Health (or currently working towards)
  • Current First Aid & CPR
  • NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working with Children Check
  • Driver’s license and reliable vehicle with CTP insurance
  • A good sense of humor (non-negotiable — trust us)

If you’re someone who shows up, gets things done, and brings a little sunshine into someone’s day — no capes, no egos, just real people making real differences — then hit Apply Now.

Join a team that believes support work should be equal parts heart, humor, and hustle.
